items.title: Through 7 games, the quartet of Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu, Jock Landale, and Lu Dort is 27-111 (24.3%) from three-point range.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Through 7 games, the quartet of Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu, Jock Landale, and Lu Dort is 27-111 (24.3%) from three-point range.

Last season, those 4 players combined to shoot 36.1% over nearly 1,300 attempts.

Seems safe to project more shots will be falling in the future.

items.title: Onyeka Okongwu had six 20-10 games last season. Tonight in a win vs the Cavaliers, he had his first, producing season highs of 29 points and 12 rebounds, both game-highs.
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Onyeka Okongwu had six 20-10 games last season. Tonight in a win vs the Cavaliers, he had his first, producing season highs of 29 points and 12 rebounds, both game-highs. 

Atlanta outscored the Cavaliers 15-4 on fast break points.
